question: How does the merit of gifting the Śrī Cakra compare to installing Viṣṇu images?
premises: Installing a crore of Viṣṇu images yields a certain fruit.
The giver of the Śrī Cakra obtains that same fruit.
inference: Gifting the Śrī Cakra equals the merit of installing countless images of Viṣṇu.
plain_english: He certainly obtains the fruit of installing ten million images of Viṣṇu.
